# Virtual Sex Dice

> An interactive 3D dice game for couples. Roll up to six customizable dice — whichever face lands up on each die builds a playful prompt sentence combining an activity, a location, an intensity, and a duration. Private, browser-based, works on any modern device.

## What it is
Virtual Sex Dice is a web app — not a native app or a physical product. It runs entirely in the browser using WebGL. The dice are rendered with Three.js and obey a hand-rolled physics model (gravity, floor bounce, dice-to-dice collision). The prompt sentence at the top of the screen is built directly from whichever face lands up on each die — not from a separate random draw.

## Who it's for
Couples looking for a playful, low-effort way to spice things up in the bedroom. Also works well for solo play and for long-distance partners sharing a screen.

## Key features
- **Real 3D physics**: dice actually tumble, collide, and settle — not a random-number animation dressed up as a roll.
- **Customizable faces**: pick which dice categories are active (activity, location, intensity, duration) and edit every face to suit your relationship.
- **Multiple activity flavors**: three starter activity dice — M/F, M/M, F/F — so the prompts fit.
- **Multi-language**: English, Spanish, German, French, and Italian, each with its own localized dice library.
- **Shake to roll**: on phones with motion sensors, shake to throw the dice.
- **Works on any device**: mobile-first, but equally usable on tablet or desktop.
- **Private by default**: no signup, no account, no tracking.

## What this site is not
- Not a physical dice product — nothing is shipped or purchased.
- Not an adult video or image site — it is a game with text prompts.
- Not a chat, match, or dating service — there are no other users.
- No user accounts are required to play.
